{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're working hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, doing this is for my own good.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Even if it's a bit of a bother, there's nothing for it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
